The '''Zandrax system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The uninhabited system was the site of a rendezvous between the [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']] and the [[Banshee (Baudo-class)|''Banshee'']], following the [[Mission to Felucia (Imperial Period)|Mission to Felucia]].
